newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI SLIPS ON PROFIT-TAKING, TRADE THIN.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI SLIPS ON PROFIT-TAKING, TRADE THIN.

text.p: Shares fell in thin trade on
Friday after U.S. stocks took a breather overnight and investors
pocketed some profits following steep gains in Finnish stocks
this week, brokers said.
"A one percent drop for the day is probably realistic (but)
there aren't any signs of the decline steepening," one broker
said, with the FOX index off about 0.9 percent.
Nokia traded 3.00 markka lower at 443.00, matching its lower
overnight Wall Street close, but off a session low of 438.00.
Trade was a modest million markka.
The week's stellar performer Raisio retreated.
Raisio surrendered 27.00 markka to trade at 613.00, but off
a session low of 610.00. Volume in the share was still fair at
about 30 million markka, but trade was much calmer than in the
past three sessions after the group on Tuesday announced a U.S.
partnership on its Benecol cholesterol-cutting food ingredient.
Raisio briefly pared losses but then fell back again after
releasing some further details of its deal with Johnson &
Johnson's McNeil on the North American Benecol marketing.
One broker expected the share to stabilise in the low 600s.
